Subject: Renewal runway — BrightHealth onboarding refresh and split-PO plan

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the continued partnership. We're preparing BrightHealth's annual renewal and are planning a modest capacity increase (approx +30% compute/seat uplift) starting in January. Two asks from our procurement team:

1) We need a short vendor onboarding refresh for our procurement portal (recently updated fields require a SOC2 attestation and a vendor contact for invoices). Can you provide the evidence bundle Redwood uploads into our portal? We can re-open the vendor entry at https://procure.brighthealth.com/vendor/onboard/12345 if you confirm.

2) Budget constraints this fiscal quarter mean we will likely split the PO into two line items (initial commit now, remainder as a top-up in Q2). Please confirm if Redwood can support a split-PO/invoice arrangement and any accounting impact on pricing or onboarding timelines.

I've attached a short cover note (BrightHealth_Renewal_Request.pdf) with totals and preferred billing contacts.

Can we get a mutual action plan + updated SOW to share with procurement by end of week?

Best,
Anna Lang
Procurement Manager, BrightHealth
anna.lang@brighthealth.com

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and the cover document.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support a split PO and staged invoices; and yes, we will submit the SOC2 attestation + onboarding evidence into your vendor portal.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
- Today (11/16): Redwood to confirm evidence bundle and point of contact (Jordan + Olga).
- 11/17: Redwood to share SOW draft and revised quote with line-item split (initial commit / Q2 top-up).
- 11/18: Procurement portal evidence uploaded; procurement sends confirmation + DocuSign routing.
- 11/22: Both sides sign SOW / PO; Finance to provision invoices per agreed split.

Meeting: I can do a 30-min sync tomorrow 11/17 at 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT. Which works for you? If helpful, I'll include Laura (AMs) for scope and Ben (Finance) for billing.

Action for us now: Olga and I will bundle the SOC2 attestation, a two-page vendor summary, and a draft SOW (SOW-BrightHealth-v2.docx). Expect the draft by 11/17 EOD.

Thanks — we'll keep the split PO language simple (initial invoice for 60% / top-up 40%) unless procurement requests a different split.

—Jordan Blake
